```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Matrix)
  library(Seurat)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
})

# ============================================================
# 1. PARAMETERS
# ============================================================

SEURAT_OBJ <- MG.recluster.obj

RNA_ASSAY <- "RNA"

PATHWAY_ASSAYS <- c(
  "AUCell",
  "UCell",
  "singscore",
  "ssgsea",
  "JASMINE"
)

BENCH_ASSAYS <- c(RNA_ASSAY, PATHWAY_ASSAYS)

RNA_SLOT <- "data"
PATHWAY_SLOT <- "data"

MEAN_THRESHOLD <- 1e-3
ENTROPY_BINS <- 30

ASSAY_COLOURS <- c(
  RNA       = "#455A64",
  AUCell    = "#1E88E5",
  UCell     = "#43A047",
  singscore = "#FB8C00",
  ssgsea    = "#8E24AA",
  JASMINE   = "#E53935"
)

# ============================================================
# 2. CORE MATRIX HELPERS
# ============================================================

prepare_matrix <- function(seurat_obj, assay_name, slot_name = "data") {
  
  stopifnot(assay_name %in% names(seurat_obj@assays))
  
  mat <- tryCatch(
    GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = assay_name, layer = slot_name),
    error = function(e) {
      GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = assay_name, slot = slot_name)
    }
  )
  
  if (!inherits(mat, "sparseMatrix")) {
    mat <- Matrix(mat, sparse = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (!all(colnames(mat) %in% colnames(seurat_obj)) &&
      all(rownames(mat) %in% colnames(seurat_obj))) {
    mat <- t(mat)
  }
  
  mat <- as(mat, "dgCMatrix")
  
  cat(sprintf(
    "[%s] %d features x %d cells (%s)\n",
    assay_name, nrow(mat), ncol(mat), slot_name
  ))
  
  mat
}


sample_matrix_values <- function(mat, n_sample = 1e5, seed = 42) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  n_total <- prod(dim(mat))
  n_take <- min(n_sample, n_total)
  
  idx <- sample.int(n_total, n_take)
  
  as.numeric(mat[idx])
}


calc_zero_metrics <- function(mat, assay_name = "") {
  
  mat <- as(mat, "dgCMatrix")
  
  n_feat <- nrow(mat)
  n_cell <- ncol(mat)
  
  overall_zero <- 1 - Matrix::nnzero(mat) / (n_feat * n_cell)
  
  row_nnz <- tabulate(mat@i + 1L, nbins = n_feat)
  col_nnz <- diff(mat@p)
  
  feat_zero <- 1 - row_nnz / n_cell
  cell_zero <- 1 - col_nnz / n_feat
  
  names(feat_zero) <- rownames(mat)
  names(cell_zero) <- colnames(mat)
  
  list(
    assay = assay_name,
    n_features = n_feat,
    n_cells = n_cell,
    overall_zero_prop = overall_zero,
    per_feature_zero = feat_zero,
    per_cell_zero = cell_zero
  )
}


calc_feature_dispersion <- function(mat,
                                    assay_name = "",
                                    mean_threshold = MEAN_THRESHOLD) {
  
  mat <- as(mat, "dgCMatrix")
  
  feat_mean <- Matrix::rowMeans(mat)
  feat_var  <- Matrix::rowMeans(mat^2) - feat_mean^2
  feat_sd   <- sqrt(pmax(feat_var, 0))
  
  feat_cv <- ifelse(
    feat_mean > mean_threshold,
    feat_sd / feat_mean,
    NA_real_
  )
  
  data.frame(
    assay = assay_name,
    feature = rownames(mat),
    mean = feat_mean,
    variance = feat_var,
    sd = feat_sd,
    cv = feat_cv,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


calc_entropy <- function(mat,
                         assay_name = "",
                         n_bins = ENTROPY_BINS) {
  
  mat <- as(mat, "dgCMatrix")
  
  n_feat <- nrow(mat)
  n_cell <- ncol(mat)
  
  if (length(mat@x) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      assay = assay_name,
      feature = rownames(mat),
      entropy = 0,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  val_range <- range(mat@x)
  
  if (val_range[1] == val_range[2]) {
    breaks <- c(-Inf, val_range[1], Inf)
  } else {
    breaks <- c(
      -Inf,
      seq(val_range[1], val_range[2], length.out = n_bins),
      Inf
    )
  }
  
  bin_ids <- findInterval(mat@x, breaks)
  row_ids <- mat@i + 1L
  
  row_nnz <- tabulate(row_ids, nbins = n_feat)
  n_zeros <- n_cell - row_nnz
  
  count_mat <- sparseMatrix(
    i = row_ids,
    j = bin_ids,
    x = 1,
    dims = c(n_feat, length(breaks))
  )
  
  count_mat[, 1] <- count_mat[, 1] + n_zeros
  
  count_dense <- as.matrix(count_mat)
  
  ent_vec <- apply(count_dense, 1, function(x) {
    p <- x[x > 0] / n_cell
    -sum(p * log2(p))
  })
  
  data.frame(
    assay = assay_name,
    feature = rownames(mat),
    entropy = ent_vec,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


ks_test_matrices <- function(mat_ref,
                             mat_comp,
                             assay_ref = "RNA",
                             assay_comp = "",
                             n_sample = 1e5,
                             seed = 42) {
  
  vals_ref <- sample_matrix_values(
    mat_ref,
    n_sample = n_sample,
    seed = seed
  )
  
  vals_comp <- sample_matrix_values(
    mat_comp,
    n_sample = n_sample,
    seed = seed + 1
  )
  
  ks <- suppressWarnings(
    ks.test(vals_ref, vals_comp)
  )
  
  data.frame(
    comparison = paste(assay_ref, "vs", assay_comp),
    assay = assay_comp,
    ks_D = as.numeric(ks$statistic),
    ks_p = ks$p.value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 3. RUN MATRIX BENCHMARK
# ============================================================

run_matrix_benchmark <- function(seurat_obj,
                                 rna_assay = RNA_ASSAY,
                                 pathway_assays = PATHWAY_ASSAYS,
                                 rna_slot = RNA_SLOT,
                                 pathway_slot = PATHWAY_SLOT,
                                 mean_threshold = MEAN_THRESHOLD,
                                 n_bins = ENTROPY_BINS) {
  
  all_assays <- c(rna_assay, pathway_assays)
  
  missing_assays <- setdiff(all_assays, names(seurat_obj@assays))
  
  if (length(missing_assays) > 0) {
    warning(
      "These requested assays are missing and will be skipped: ",
      paste(missing_assays, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  all_assays <- all_assays[all_assays %in% names(seurat_obj@assays)]
  
  slots <- ifelse(all_assays == rna_assay, rna_slot, pathway_slot)
  
  mats <- setNames(
    mapply(
      prepare_matrix,
      assay_name = all_assays,
      slot_name = slots,
      MoreArgs = list(seurat_obj = seurat_obj),
      SIMPLIFY = FALSE
    ),
    all_assays
  )
  
  cat("\n--- Computing zero metrics ---\n")
  
  zero_list <- lapply(all_assays, function(a) {
    calc_zero_metrics(mats[[a]], a)
  })
  names(zero_list) <- all_assays
  
  cat("\n--- Computing dispersion metrics ---\n")
  
  disp_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(all_assays, function(a) {
    calc_feature_dispersion(
      mats[[a]],
      assay_name = a,
      mean_threshold = mean_threshold
    )
  }))
  
  cat("\n--- Computing Shannon entropy ---\n")
  
  ent_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(all_assays, function(a) {
    calc_entropy(
      mats[[a]],
      assay_name = a,
      n_bins = n_bins
    )
  }))
  
  cat("\n--- Running KS tests vs RNA ---\n")
  
  ks_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(setdiff(all_assays, rna_assay), function(a) {
    ks_test_matrices(
      mat_ref = mats[[rna_assay]],
      mat_comp = mats[[a]],
      assay_ref = rna_assay,
      assay_comp = a
    )
  }))
  
  list(
    matrices = mats,
    zero_list = zero_list,
    disp_df = disp_df,
    ent_df = ent_df,
    ks_df = ks_df,
    all_assays = all_assays
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 4. SHARED METRIC INFO
# ============================================================

get_metric_info <- function() {
  
  data.frame(
    metric = c(
      "feature_zero",
      "cell_zero",
      "cv",
      "z_value",
      "entropy",
      "ks_D"
    ),
    metric_label = c(
      "Feature\nzero",
      "Cell\nzero",
      "CV",
      "Z-score\nvalue",
      "Shannon\nentropy",
      "KS D\nvs RNA"
    ),
    category = c(
      "Sparsity",
      "Sparsity",
      "Dispersion",
      "Distribution",
      "Entropy",
      "KS test"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 5. EMBEDDED BOXPLOT DATA
# ============================================================

make_embedded_boxplot_data <- function(bench,
                                       assay_order = BENCH_ASSAYS,
                                       n_sample_value = 5e4,
                                       seed = 42) {
  
  feature_zero_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bench$zero_list, function(z) {
    data.frame(
      assay = z$assay,
      metric = "feature_zero",
      value = z$per_feature_zero,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  cell_zero_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bench$zero_list, function(z) {
    data.frame(
      assay = z$assay,
      metric = "cell_zero",
      value = z$per_cell_zero,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  cv_df <- bench$disp_df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      assay,
      metric = "cv",
      value = cv
    )
  
  entropy_df <- bench$ent_df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      assay,
      metric = "entropy",
      value = entropy
    )
  
  zvalue_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bench$all_assays, function(a) {
    
    mat <- bench$matrices[[a]]
    
    vals <- sample_matrix_values(
      mat,
      n_sample = n_sample_value,
      seed = seed
    )
    
    if (sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      vals <- as.numeric(scale(vals))
    } else {
      vals <- rep(0, length(vals))
    }
    
    data.frame(
      assay = a,
      metric = "z_value",
      value = vals,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    feature_zero_df,
    cell_zero_df,
    cv_df,
    entropy_df,
    zvalue_df
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(value), !is.na(value)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay = factor(assay, levels = assay_order)
    )
}


make_embedded_scalar_data <- function(bench,
                                      assay_order = BENCH_ASSAYS) {
  
  ks_df <- bench$ks_df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      assay = assay,
      metric = "ks_D",
      value = ks_D
    )
  
  ks_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      assay = RNA_ASSAY,
      metric = "ks_D",
      value = 0,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    ks_df
  )
  
  ks_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay = factor(assay, levels = assay_order)
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 6. EMBEDDED BOXPLOT STATS
# ============================================================

make_embedded_boxplot_stats <- function(box_df,
                                        scalar_df,
                                        assay_order = BENCH_ASSAYS,
                                        assay_colours = ASSAY_COLOURS) {
  
  metric_info <- get_metric_info()
  
  range_box <- box_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      metric_min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      metric_max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  range_scalar <- scalar_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      metric_min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      metric_max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  metric_range <- dplyr::bind_rows(range_box, range_scalar) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(metric, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  box_stats <- box_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(assay, metric) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      q05 = quantile(value, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q50 = quantile(value, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      q95 = quantile(value, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(metric_range, by = "metric") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(metric_info, by = "metric") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay_chr = as.character(assay),
      assay_colour = assay_colours[assay_chr],
      
      metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_info$metric),
      assay = factor(assay, levels = rev(assay_order)),
      
      x = as.numeric(metric),
      y = as.numeric(assay),
      
      denom = metric_max - metric_min,
      denom = ifelse(denom == 0 | is.na(denom), 1, denom),
      
      q05_s = (q05 - metric_min) / denom,
      q25_s = (q25 - metric_min) / denom,
      q50_s = (q50 - metric_min) / denom,
      q75_s = (q75 - metric_min) / denom,
      q95_s = (q95 - metric_min) / denom,
      
      xmin05 = x - 0.38 + 0.76 * q05_s,
      xmin25 = x - 0.38 + 0.76 * q25_s,
      xmed   = x - 0.38 + 0.76 * q50_s,
      xmax75 = x - 0.38 + 0.76 * q75_s,
      xmax95 = x - 0.38 + 0.76 * q95_s,
      
      label = dplyr::case_when(
        metric %in% c("feature_zero", "cell_zero") ~
          scales::percent(q50, accuracy = 0.1),
        TRUE ~
          format(round(q50, 3), nsmall = 3)
      )
    )
  
  scalar_stats <- scalar_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(metric_range, by = "metric") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(metric_info, by = "metric") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay_chr = as.character(assay),
      assay_colour = assay_colours[assay_chr],
      
      metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_info$metric),
      assay = factor(assay, levels = rev(assay_order)),
      
      x = as.numeric(metric),
      y = as.numeric(assay),
      
      denom = metric_max - metric_min,
      denom = ifelse(denom == 0 | is.na(denom), 1, denom),
      
      value_s = (value - metric_min) / denom,
      xbar_end = x - 0.38 + 0.76 * value_s,
      
      label = format(round(value, 3), nsmall = 3)
    )
  
  list(
    box_stats = box_stats,
    scalar_stats = scalar_stats,
    metric_info = metric_info
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 7. PLOT: EMBEDDED MINI-BOXPLOT TABLE
# ============================================================

plot_embedded_boxplot_table <- function(bench,
                                        assay_order = BENCH_ASSAYS,
                                        assay_colours = ASSAY_COLOURS) {
  
  box_df <- make_embedded_boxplot_data(
    bench = bench,
    assay_order = assay_order
  )
  
  scalar_df <- make_embedded_scalar_data(
    bench = bench,
    assay_order = assay_order
  )
  
  stats <- make_embedded_boxplot_stats(
    box_df = box_df,
    scalar_df = scalar_df,
    assay_order = assay_order,
    assay_colours = assay_colours
  )
  
  box_stats <- stats$box_stats
  scalar_stats <- stats$scalar_stats
  metric_info <- stats$metric_info
  
  metric_info_plot <- metric_info %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_info$metric),
      x = as.numeric(metric)
    )
  
  category_df <- metric_info_plot %>%
    dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      xmin = min(x) - 0.5,
      xmax = max(x) + 0.5,
      xmid = mean(range(x)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  n_assays <- length(assay_order)
  
  bg_df <- expand.grid(
    x = seq_along(metric_info$metric),
    y = seq_along(rev(assay_order))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bg_fill = ifelse(y %% 2 == 0, "grey92", "white")
    )
  
  metric_header_df <- data.frame(
    x = metric_info_plot$x,
    label = metric_info$metric_label,
    y = n_assays + 0.55
  )
  
  category_header_df <- category_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ymin = n_assays + 1.08,
      ymax = n_assays + 1.52
    )
  
  category_cols <- c(
    "Sparsity"     = "#DCEAF7",
    "Dispersion"   = "#FCE5CD",
    "Distribution" = "#EADCF8",
    "Entropy"      = "#D9EAD3",
    "KS test"      = "#F4CCCC"
  )
  
  ggplot() +
    
    geom_rect(
      data = bg_df,
      aes(
        xmin = x - 0.5,
        xmax = x + 0.5,
        ymin = y - 0.5,
        ymax = y + 0.5
      ),
      fill = bg_df$bg_fill,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_segment(
      data = scalar_stats,
      aes(
        x = x - 0.38,
        xend = xbar_end,
        y = y - 0.08,
        yend = y - 0.08,
        color = assay_chr
      ),
      linewidth = 3.2,
      alpha = 0.9,
      lineend = "butt",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_segment(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(
        x = xmin05,
        xend = xmax95,
        y = y - 0.08,
        yend = y - 0.08
      ),
      linewidth = 0.45,
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    
    geom_rect(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(
        xmin = xmin25,
        xmax = xmax75,
        ymin = y - 0.20,
        ymax = y + 0.04,
        fill = assay_chr
      ),
      alpha = 0.75,
      color = "grey15",
      linewidth = 0.35,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_segment(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(
        x = xmed,
        xend = xmed,
        y = y - 0.22,
        yend = y + 0.06
      ),
      linewidth = 0.5,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = box_stats,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y + 0.23,
        label = label
      ),
      size = 2.9,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = scalar_stats,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y + 0.23,
        label = label
      ),
      size = 2.9,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_rect(
      data = metric_header_df,
      aes(
        xmin = x - 0.5,
        xmax = x + 0.5,
        ymin = y - 0.35,
        ymax = y + 0.35
      ),
      fill = "grey98",
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = metric_header_df,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        label = label
      ),
      size = 3.6,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "grey20",
      lineheight = 0.95
    ) +
    
    geom_rect(
      data = category_header_df,
      aes(
        xmin = xmin,
        xmax = xmax,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax
      ),
      fill = category_cols[as.character(category_header_df$category)],
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = category_header_df,
      aes(
        x = xmid,
        y = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
        label = category
      ),
      size = 4.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey55",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = assay_colours) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = assay_colours, guide = "none") +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = metric_info_plot$x,
      labels = rep("", nrow(metric_info_plot)),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(rev(assay_order)),
      labels = rev(assay_order),
      limits = c(0.5, n_assays + 1.75),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14,
        color = "grey25"
      ),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15)
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 8. EMBEDDED BARPLOT TABLE DATA
# ============================================================

make_embedded_bar_table_data <- function(bench,
                                         assay_order = BENCH_ASSAYS,
                                         n_sample_value = 5e4,
                                         seed = 42) {
  
  feature_zero_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bench$zero_list, function(z) {
    data.frame(
      assay = z$assay,
      metric = "feature_zero",
      value = median(z$per_feature_zero, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  cell_zero_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bench$zero_list, function(z) {
    data.frame(
      assay = z$assay,
      metric = "cell_zero",
      value = median(z$per_cell_zero, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  cv_df <- bench$disp_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(assay) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      value = median(cv, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(metric = "cv") %>%
    dplyr::select(assay, metric, value)
  
  zvalue_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(bench$all_assays, function(a) {
    
    mat <- bench$matrices[[a]]
    
    vals <- sample_matrix_values(
      mat,
      n_sample = n_sample_value,
      seed = seed
    )
    
    if (sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
      vals <- as.numeric(scale(vals))
    } else {
      vals <- rep(0, length(vals))
    }
    
    data.frame(
      assay = a,
      metric = "z_value",
      value = median(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  
  entropy_df <- bench$ent_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(assay) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      value = median(entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(metric = "entropy") %>%
    dplyr::select(assay, metric, value)
  
  ks_df <- make_embedded_scalar_data(
    bench = bench,
    assay_order = assay_order
  ) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      assay,
      metric,
      value
    )
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    feature_zero_df,
    cell_zero_df,
    cv_df,
    zvalue_df,
    entropy_df,
    ks_df
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(value), !is.na(value)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay = factor(assay, levels = assay_order)
    )
}


make_embedded_bar_table_stats <- function(bar_df,
                                          assay_order = BENCH_ASSAYS,
                                          assay_colours = ASSAY_COLOURS) {
  
  metric_info <- get_metric_info()
  
  metric_range <- bar_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(metric) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      metric_min = min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      metric_max = max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  bar_stats <- bar_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(metric_range, by = "metric") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(metric_info, by = "metric") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay_chr = as.character(assay),
      assay_colour = assay_colours[assay_chr],
      
      metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_info$metric),
      assay = factor(assay, levels = rev(assay_order)),
      
      x = as.numeric(metric),
      y = as.numeric(assay),
      
      denom = metric_max - metric_min,
      denom = ifelse(denom == 0 | is.na(denom), 1, denom),
      
      value_scaled = (value - metric_min) / denom,
      
      xbar_start = x - 0.38,
      xbar_end = x - 0.38 + 0.76 * value_scaled,
      
      label = dplyr::case_when(
        metric %in% c("feature_zero", "cell_zero") ~
          scales::percent(value, accuracy = 0.1),
        TRUE ~
          format(round(value, 3), nsmall = 3)
      )
    )
  
  list(
    bar_stats = bar_stats,
    metric_info = metric_info
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 9. PLOT: EMBEDDED BARPLOT TABLE
# ============================================================

plot_embedded_barplot_table <- function(bench,
                                        assay_order = BENCH_ASSAYS,
                                        assay_colours = ASSAY_COLOURS,
                                        n_sample_value = 5e4,
                                        seed = 42) {
  
  bar_df <- make_embedded_bar_table_data(
    bench = bench,
    assay_order = assay_order,
    n_sample_value = n_sample_value,
    seed = seed
  )
  
  stats <- make_embedded_bar_table_stats(
    bar_df = bar_df,
    assay_order = assay_order,
    assay_colours = assay_colours
  )
  
  bar_stats <- stats$bar_stats
  metric_info <- stats$metric_info
  
  metric_info_plot <- metric_info %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      metric = factor(metric, levels = metric_info$metric),
      x = as.numeric(metric)
    )
  
  category_df <- metric_info_plot %>%
    dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      xmin = min(x) - 0.5,
      xmax = max(x) + 0.5,
      xmid = mean(range(x)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  n_assays <- length(assay_order)
  
  bg_df <- expand.grid(
    x = seq_along(metric_info$metric),
    y = seq_along(rev(assay_order))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      bg_fill = ifelse(y %% 2 == 0, "grey92", "white")
    )
  
  metric_header_df <- data.frame(
    x = metric_info_plot$x,
    label = metric_info$metric_label,
    y = n_assays + 0.55
  )
  
  category_header_df <- category_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ymin = n_assays + 1.08,
      ymax = n_assays + 1.52
    )
  
  category_cols <- c(
    "Sparsity"     = "#DCEAF7",
    "Dispersion"   = "#FCE5CD",
    "Distribution" = "#EADCF8",
    "Entropy"      = "#D9EAD3",
    "KS test"      = "#F4CCCC"
  )
  
  ggplot() +
    
    geom_rect(
      data = bg_df,
      aes(
        xmin = x - 0.5,
        xmax = x + 0.5,
        ymin = y - 0.5,
        ymax = y + 0.5
      ),
      fill = bg_df$bg_fill,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.7,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_segment(
      data = bar_stats,
      aes(
        x = xbar_start,
        xend = xbar_end,
        y = y - 0.08,
        yend = y - 0.08,
        color = assay_chr
      ),
      linewidth = 4.0,
      alpha = 0.9,
      lineend = "butt",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = bar_stats,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y + 0.23,
        label = label
      ),
      size = 2.9,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_rect(
      data = metric_header_df,
      aes(
        xmin = x - 0.5,
        xmax = x + 0.5,
        ymin = y - 0.35,
        ymax = y + 0.35
      ),
      fill = "grey98",
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = metric_header_df,
      aes(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        label = label
      ),
      size = 3.6,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "grey20",
      lineheight = 0.95
    ) +
    
    geom_rect(
      data = category_header_df,
      aes(
        xmin = xmin,
        xmax = xmax,
        ymin = ymin,
        ymax = ymax
      ),
      fill = category_cols[as.character(category_header_df$category)],
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    
    geom_text(
      data = category_header_df,
      aes(
        x = xmid,
        y = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
        label = category
      ),
      size = 4.2,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(2.5, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey55",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = assay_colours) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = metric_info_plot$x,
      labels = rep("", nrow(metric_info_plot)),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(rev(assay_order)),
      labels = rev(assay_order),
      limits = c(0.5, n_assays + 1.75),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 14,
        color = "grey25"
      ),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15)
    )
}

# ============================================================
# 10. NUMERIC SUMMARY EXPORT
# ============================================================

make_matrix_benchmark_numeric_summary <- function(bench,
                                                  assay_order = BENCH_ASSAYS,
                                                  n_sample_value = 5e4,
                                                  seed = 42) {
  
  box_df <- make_embedded_boxplot_data(
    bench = bench,
    assay_order = assay_order,
    n_sample_value = n_sample_value,
    seed = seed
  )
  
  scalar_df <- make_embedded_scalar_data(
    bench = bench,
    assay_order = assay_order
  )
  
  box_summary <- box_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(assay, metric) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      q05 = quantile(value, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      q95 = quantile(value, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  scalar_summary <- scalar_df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      assay,
      metric,
      q05 = value,
      q25 = value,
      median = value,
      q75 = value,
      q95 = value,
      mean = value
    )
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    box_summary,
    scalar_summary
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      assay = factor(assay, levels = assay_order)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(assay, metric)
}
```
